mechanism_narrative: Sustained elevation in RESIDENTIAL mobility above 10 percent change from baseline forces consumer activity into the home and suppresses retail-and-recreation trips, so RETAIL_REC continues to fall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 7.0 to 13.7 over the last four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 percent change from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT breaching -25 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks signals a collapse in commuting capacity that removes incidental retail footfall, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT < -25 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell to -27.0 in week t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -25 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL and depressed WORKPLACES interact to remove the daily commute and office-adjacent retail trips, so the joint condition of RESIDENTIAL above 10 and WORKPLACES below -15 predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL=13.7 and WORKPLACES=-19.9 in week t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 and WORKPLACES stays below -15.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, elevated GROCERY_PHARM above 15 percent change from baseline indicates essential spending is redirected away from general retail, so RETAIL_REC stays lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM=19.4 in week t-0w, still above 15
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains above 15 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The year-end festive shopping period and Singapore's move to Phase 3 on 2020-12-28 raise retail-and-recreation activity even though recent RETAIL_REC has declined, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date is 2020-12-15, ahead of Christmas and New Year
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite the year-end holiday and Phase 3 reopening period.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility falling below -20 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks signals reduced outdoor recreation, which removes a complementary driver of retail trips and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS < -20 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS remains below -20 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 1 point while TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points week-on-week, households substitute home-based activity for transit-based retail trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises >1 point and TRANSIT falls >2 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose 1.4 points and TRANSIT fell 2.7 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises >1 point and TRANSIT falls >2 points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES recovers above -10 or TRANSIT recovers above -20 during the reopening regime, commuting and transit footfall restore retail-and-recreation activity, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES=-19.9 and TRANSIT=-27.0 in week t-0w, below recovery thresholds
failure_condition: WORKPLACES exceeds -10 or TRANSIT exceeds -20 during the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.
